svg.title: TCP under netem loss and latency
svg.text: 31 · TCP under netem loss and latency

g.text: Baseline: iperf3 data crosses r1 with low RTT; ACKs return quickly and the congestion window grows.
On r1 eth2: tc qdisc replace dev eth2 root netem delay 50ms loss 1% — egress packets delayed, some
Segment 4 is dropped on r1 eth2. h2 keeps acknowledging the last in-order byte; duplicate ACKs reach h1.
Three dup ACKs trigger fast retransmit before the RTO fires; cwnd is halved and the flow slows down.
tc qdisc del dev eth2 root removes netem: RTT and throughput return toward baseline. Loss, not
